job.title: Project Manager – Product & Technology Delivery
job.description:
Project Manager – Product & Technology Delivery
Arena | Vietnam (on-site with the development team) | 12-month contract

Arena is an Australian sports technology start-up building the dedicated digital home for sport. It’s a mobile-first platform that brings athletes, teams, leagues, fans and brands together in one place, without the noise of general-purpose social media.

Leadership is in Australia. The development team is in Vietnam. This role connects the two.

The role

You’ll be the day-to-day link between Arena’s Australian Product and Technology Leads and its Vietnam development team. That means working across time zones, and also across languages, working styles and ways of communicating.

You’ll make sure priorities are properly understood, not just passed on. You’ll sequence the work, manage dependencies, spot risks early and give leadership a reliable view of progress. You’ll also make it easy for the Vietnam team to ask questions, push back on unclear requirements and raise concerns early, and help Australian stakeholders understand local context and constraints.

What you’ll do

  • Turn agreed priorities into practical delivery plans, schedules and milestones across mobile, web and platform work
  • Run the delivery rhythm: planning, stand-ups, progress reviews and follow-up
  • Explain the “why” behind decisions to the Vietnam team, and bring the team’s perspective back to Australia
  • Manage the flow of requirements, feedback and scope changes between the two teams
  • Coordinate testing, release readiness and launch activity with Engineering and QA
  • Give clear, concise updates to the Product and Technology Leads, CEO and Founder
  • Set up simple, practical project management habits without adding bureaucracy

What you’ll bring

  • 4–7+ years in project management, digital delivery or IT project management, ideally on software or digital product projects in Agile teams
  • Experience bridging communication and cultural differences between Western (ideally Australian) stakeholders and Vietnamese or other Asian delivery teams
  • Strong planning, scheduling and dependency management, using Jira and Confluence or similar tools
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to deal directly with senior Australian leaders
  • Based in Vietnam and able to work closely with the local team

It’s highly regarded if you also have:

  • Fluent Vietnamese
  • Experience with Australian technology companies
  • A background in consumer apps or digital products
  • Start-up or product launch experience

A software engineering background is not required.

What’s on offer

  • A 6 or 12-month contract, with scope to extend or move to a longer-term engagement
  • A visible role at an important stage, as Arena moves through launch and into growth
  • A direct say in how the business delivers its product, working closely with Australian leadership and an established development team

Interested?

If you’d like to talk about the role confidentially, contact me directly.

Kylie Kneale
Partner, Think Talent
kylie@thinktalent.com.au

job.title: National Sales Manager, Retail - Charlotte USA
job.description:
Lead the team. Shape the retail strategy. Grow Coolaroo's reach.
If you know how to build a successful partnership between a consumer brand and a home improvement retailer, this role brings together national account influence and hands-on sales leadership.

Think Talent is partnering with GALE Pacific to appoint a National Sales Manager for its Americas Home Center business. The company behind Coolaroo combines Australian heritage with global product development and manufacturing expertise. Its shade and outdoor living products help people create more comfortable, usable outdoor spaces.

Your opportunity
Reporting to the VP Sales & Trade Marketing Americas, you'll lead a Key Account Manager, Sales Analyst and part-time Merchandiser. You'll have scope to shape account strategy, develop your team and influence how products reach customers in stores and online.

Your priorities will include:

  • Growing retail sales and distribution while protecting profitability.
  • Leading product line reviews and securing retailer support for launches.
  • Coaching the team and building relationships across retailer functions.
  • Turning sales, inventory and promotional insights into better forecasts and execution.
  • Working with Marketing, Product and Supply Chain to deliver on customer commitments.


What will help you succeed

  • You bring experience managing a sales team and working with home center retailers, backed by at least five years' relevant sales experience.
  • You understand the commercial detail behind an account plan and can show how you've influenced buyers, grown a category or improved team performance.
  • Experience in home improvement, outdoor living, garden, building products or adjacent consumer categories could translate well.


Based in Charlotte, you'll work Tuesday to Thursday in the office, with Monday and Friday remote.

To apply, send your résumé through LinkedIn. If you'd like a confidential conversation first, contact Jules Holland at Think Talent on jules@thinktalent.com.au.

Think Talent welcomes applications from all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment during the recruitment process, please let us know.

job.title: Account Manager - Commercial - Charlotte, North Carolina, USA
job.description:
Charlotte, North Carolina | Approximately US$110,000 base + short-term incentive + benefits

Build stronger partnerships. Find the next opportunity within them.

GALE Pacific is a global leader in advanced polymer fabrics and outdoor shade solutions. With more than 75 years of experience, its products help protect people, animals, crops and outdoor spaces from the sun’s harsh effects. As the business grows, it is becoming a more insight-led, solutions-focused commercial partner.

We’re looking for an Account Manager to take ownership of established commercial customers, including two significant existing accounts. You’ll build a deep understanding of their businesses, protect and grow those relationships, and identify where GALE Pacific can deliver more value.

What you’ll do

  • Develop trusted relationships with fabricators, distributors and commercial partners.
  • Build account plans that support retention, profitable growth and greater product adoption.
  • Identify opportunities to expand into new products, applications and categories, including converting customers from competitor solutions.
  • Lead pricing and commercial conversations with a clear view of margin and long-term account value.
  • Work with supply chain, operations, technical and customer service teams to deliver on customer commitments.
  • Take ownership of new accounts secured by the Business Development team and turn early wins into lasting partnerships.
  • Keep account plans, opportunities and forecasts accurate in Salesforce.

What you’ll bring

You’ve managed and grown B2B accounts in manufacturing, distribution, construction products or a related commercial environment. You know how to move beyond day-to-day service to understand a customer’s priorities, spot growth opportunities and follow them through.

You’ll bring sound commercial judgement, confidence with stakeholders at different levels, and the ability to explain how a technical product solves a practical customer problem. Experience working with fabricators, distributors or other channel partners would be particularly valuable.

This role will suit someone who is curious, dependable and comfortable working across teams to get the right outcome for the customer and the business. You’ll also be willing to travel to meet customers and attend industry events as required.

Why GALE Pacific?

You’ll join a business with established customer relationships, strong technical capability and an ambitious growth agenda across the Americas. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact by developing the accounts already in place and helping new customer relationships thrive.

Interested? Applicants must reside in Charlotte, North Carolina, United States and hold full working rights (no visa sponsorship available). Click "apply" for prompt consideration.
